verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents card state transitions, which could be used to suspend or block a compromised card, plus velocity and authorization controls that limit spend. Gateway JIT funding lets your own system approve or deny at transaction time using your own rules, but nothing in the pack shows network fraud scores or Marqeta fraud models surfaced at auth. Missing for 10: network or platform fraud scores at authorization, suspicious-activity alerting (only generic webhooks are documented), card reissue tooling for compromised cards, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
